title: Co-Exposure to Imazalil and Tebuconazole Exacerbates Potential Risks to the Environment: Regulation of Reproductive and Metabolic Homeostasis by Targeting Aromatase.
authors: Dang, Xinrui; Miao, Jiyan; Sun, Xiaoxuan; Sun, Wei; Han, Shihang; Chen, Qi; Diao, Jinling; Zhu, Wentao
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究农药共暴露通过靶向芳香化酶干扰斑马鱼生殖与代谢，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Most previous studies have focused on the environmental risks of individual pesticide exposure, leaving a gap in research concerning combined exposures. Therefore, we conducted in vivo, in vitro, and in silico studies to uncover the environmental risks posed by the frequently concurrent application of two pesticides: imazalil (IMA) and tebuconazole (TEB). In vivo, zebrafish exposure to IMA and TEB caused gonadal damage, with a decrease in testosterone in males and 17beta-estradiol in females. The damage was exacerbated by coexposure to both pesticides. Further investigation revealed that the expression of estrogen receptors (esr1, esr2a, esr2b) and CYP19a1b was downregulated, indicating a disruption of the degree of nuclear receptor activation. In vitro experiments with KGN cells confirmed disruption of hormone secretion and downregulation of CYP19A1 (aromatase), ESR1, and StAR. In silico docking revealed a strong binding affinity between IMA, TEB, and aromatase. In conclusion, our work demonstrates that IMA and TEB induce reproductive injury and disrupt metabolic homeostasis in zebrafish by targeting aromatase, highlighting a synergistic effect between them. These results offer important insights into how combined pesticide exposures may interact synergistically to disrupt reproductive function in zebrafish.
abstract_zh: 以往的研究大多聚焦于单一农药暴露的环境风险，而对联合暴露的研究存在空白。因此，我们开展了体内、体外及计算机模拟研究，以揭示频繁同时使用的两种农药——抑霉唑（IMA）和戊唑醇（TEB）——所带来的环境风险。在体内实验中，斑马鱼暴露于IMA和TEB导致性腺损伤，雄性个体中睾酮水平下降，雌性个体中17β-雌二醇水平下降。两种农药的联合暴露加剧了这种损伤。进一步研究表明，雌激素受体（esr1、esr2a、esr2b）和CYP19a1b的表达下调，表明核受体激活程度受到干扰。使用KGN细胞的体外实验证实了激素分泌的紊乱以及CYP19A1（芳香化酶）、ESR1和StAR的下调。计算机模拟对接显示，IMA、TEB与芳香化酶之间存在强结合亲和力。总之，我们的工作表明，IMA和TEB通过靶向芳香化酶诱导斑马鱼生殖损伤并扰乱代谢稳态，凸显了它们之间的协同效应。这些结果为联合农药暴露如何协同作用以破坏斑马鱼生殖功能提供了重要见解。
